mapper.sql: c.id chunk_id,d.id textbook_id,d.title textbook_title,d.edition, c.heading_path::text heading_path,c.source_locator::text source_locator, c.content,c.content_hash
mapper.select: select syllabus_version_id,exam_subject_id from cm_knowledge_point where del_flag='0' and id in #{id} order by id limit 1

select , (1-(lower(coalesce(c.heading,'') || ' ' || c.content) <-> lower(#{queryText})))::numeric score from cm_document_chunk c join cm_document d on d.id=c.document_id where order by lower(coalesce(c.heading,'') || ' ' || c.content) <-> lower(#{queryText}),c.id limit #{limit}

select , (1-(e.embedding <=> cast(#{embedding} as vector)))::numeric score from cm_document_chunk c join cm_document d on d.id=c.document_id join cm_document_chunk_embedding e on e.chunk_id=c.id and e.status='READY' and e.content_hash=c.content_hash and e.model_name=#{embeddingModel} where order by e.embedding <=> cast(#{embedding} as vector),c.id limit #{limit}

with candidate as ( select e.chunk_id from cm_document_chunk_embedding e join cm_document_chunk c on c.id=e.chunk_id join cm_document d on d.id=c.document_id where d.document_type='textbook' and d.status='published' and d.del_flag='0' and (e.status='PENDING' or (e.status='PROCESSING' and e.lease_until < now()) or e.content_hash<>c.content_hash or e.model_name<>#{embeddingModel} or e.dimensions<>#{dimensions}) order by e.update_time,e.chunk_id for update of e skip locked limit 1 ), claimed as ( update cm_document_chunk_embedding e set content_hash=c.content_hash,model_name=#{embeddingModel},dimensions=#{dimensions}, embedding=null,status='PROCESSING',attempt_count=case when e.content_hash<>c.content_hash or e.model_name<>#{embeddingModel} then 1 else e.attempt_count+1 end, lease_until=now()+interval '2 minutes',error_code=null,update_time=now() from candidate target join cm_document_chunk c on c.id=target.chunk_id where e.chunk_id=target.chunk_id returning e.chunk_id,e.content_hash ) select claimed.chunk_id,claimed.content_hash,c.heading,c.content from claimed join cm_document_chunk c on c.id=claimed.chunk_id
mapper.update: update cm_document_chunk_embedding set status=case when attempt_count>=#{maxAttempts} then 'FAILED' else 'PENDING' end, lease_until=null,error_code=#{errorCode},update_time=now() where chunk_id=#{chunkId} and status='PROCESSING'
mapper.insert: insert into cm_document_chunk_embedding(chunk_id,content_hash,model_name,dimensions,status) select c.id,c.content_hash,#{embeddingModel},#{dimensions},'PENDING' from cm_document_chunk c where c.document_id=#{documentId} on conflict (chunk_id) do update set content_hash=excluded.content_hash, model_name=excluded.model_name,dimensions=excluded.dimensions,embedding=null,status='PENDING', attempt_count=0,lease_until=null,error_code=null,update_time=now()

insert into cm_document_chunk_embedding(chunk_id,content_hash,model_name,dimensions,status) select c.id,c.content_hash,#{embeddingModel},#{dimensions},'PENDING' from cm_document_chunk c where c.id=#{chunkId} on conflict (chunk_id) do update set content_hash=excluded.content_hash, model_name=excluded.model_name,dimensions=excluded.dimensions,embedding=null,status='PENDING', attempt_count=0,lease_until=null,error_code=null,update_time=now()
